セルフリッジズで「15歳以上向けのちいかわ」が売られている――Why London already had a place for Japanese cute

At Selfridges in London, several Chiikawa collectibles are explicitly marked for ages 15+. Starting from that odd detail, this essay traces the real route behind Chiikawa’s UK launch, the adult-oriented toy culture built by Jellycat and Squishmallows, the expanding kidult market in the UK and Europe, and MINISO’s IP-led retail strategy. The key idea is that overseas success is not only about translating a Japanese character. It is also about finding a market where the buying behavior, retail format, distribution, and experience are already ready for it.
